actors.name: Trần Duy
actors.description: Middle-aged male sect guide. Compact dark bun with grey streak, short moustache and goatee, ivory-grey robe, thin bronze trim, celadon waist token and sect-tag pouch.
actors.gesture: A calm direction-giving open palm: neutral, lifts right forearm, opens hand towards down-right, holds, retracts, exact neutral. No pointing a weapon.

actors.name: Tô Nhược
actors.description: Adult woman supplies clerk. Dark compact bun, muted jade robe, ivory cloth apron, earthy-red tied ledger, small sealed wooden case and a small brush. No beard, no child face.
